name: Limitless Nexus
description: Clean Limitless provider branch built one source at a time for maintainable anime, animation, drama, movie, and TV coverage.

scrapers.name: Re:ANIME
scrapers.description: Anime provider using TMDB/IMDb to MAL/AniList identity mapping and Re:ANIME's structured Flix API. DUB prefers direct MKV. SUB can use the shared Limitless FlixCloud proxy for rewritten/token-preserving/XOR-decoded HLS playback, with live XOR-mask discovery and exact movie identity verification.
scrapers.author: Limitless Nexus port based on maintained Re:ANIME and FlixCloud reference implementations
